title: Watch
description: A quick look while the person walks: is there something to read, and what could they trip on or walk into. Never the contents of a sign.

sign_visible.description: True if a sign, board, notice, label, packet, document, screen or currency note with readable writing is in view and big enough to read.

sign_box.description: [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] of the most readable sign, normalized 0-1000. Empty if none.

sign_key.description: Two to five words that identify WHICH sign this is (for example 'green board Ameerpet', 'red shop board'), used only to avoid reading the same sign twice. Never spoken.

hazards_en.description: At most 2 things the person could trip on, walk into or be hit by, close to them, each 3 to 8 words with its position, e.g. 'steps going down just ahead'. Empty if none. Never say a way is clear or safe.
